description: This Java class, ConfigManager, provides a centralized way to manage environment-aware configuration properties for the Selenium test suite. It loads default and environment-specific properties, supports resolution precedence from system properties, environment variables, and files, and offers various accessor methods for configuration values used in test setup and execution.

classes.name: ConfigManager
classes.description: A utility class that manages environment-specific configuration settings for the Selenium test suite, allowing layered property resolution and providing specific configuration accessors.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property value based on a resolution precedence (system property, environment variable, overlay file, base file) with a default fallback.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method returning a property value or empty string if not found.

methods.name: getRequired
methods.description: Returns the property value for a key, logging an error if it is not set.

methods.name: getActiveEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the currently active environment name, such as dev, qa, staging, or production.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the application's base URL, checking Maven property first, then configuration resolution.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the configured browser type for tests, defaulting to chrome.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Indicates whether headless mode is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getExplicitWait
methods.description: Returns the configured explicit wait timeout in seconds.

methods.name: getPageLoadTimeout
methods.description: Returns the page load timeout in seconds.

methods.name: getAdminUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the admin username for tests, requires it be set.

methods.name: getAdminPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the admin password for tests, requires it be set.

methods.name: getEssUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the ESS username, required for tests.

methods.name: getEssPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the ESS password, required for tests.

methods.name: getDbUrl
methods.description: Returns the database JDBC URL if configured.

methods.name: getDbUsername
methods.description: Returns the database username.

methods.name: getDbPassword
methods.description: Returns the database password.

methods.name: getDbDriver
methods.description: Returns the JDBC driver class name.

methods.name: isDatabaseConfigured
methods.description: Returns true if the database URL is configured, indicating database connectivity information is present.

methods.name: resolveEnvironment
methods.description: Determines the active environment name using system properties, environment variables, or default to 'dev'.

methods.name: loadProperties
methods.description: Loads a properties file from classpath into a Properties object, logging warnings if not found.

methods.name: isPresent
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-null and non-blank.

methods.name: parseIntSafe
methods.description: Safely parses an integer from a string, returning 0 on failure with a warning.
